items.title: 3 ETFs For Owning Palo Alto Networks Without The Same Bet
items.summary: Owning Palo Alto Networks directly means living with its specific issues on your own, such as Simply Wall St’s note that profit margins at 3.7% are well below last year’s 11.7%, or its warning about large one off items affecting results. A fund that holds Palo Alto Networks alongside many other businesses can reduce how much those company specific swings affect your portfolio, and also reduces how much its success moves the needle. items.title: Jim Cramer Calls CrowdStrike’s Zscaler Deal the Biggest in Cybersecurity History. What It Means for Both Stocks
